title: Fleet Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FLEET MANAGER Company: Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd.
 Industry: Transportation and Logistics
 Department: Fleet Operations
 Reporting To: Head of Department / Director
 Location: Delhi NCR
 Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd. is an established logistics company operating since 1993. The company provides Full Truck Load, Part Truck Load, local transportation, warehousing, air, rail and express cargo services across India. Job Summary The Fleet Manager will be responsible for the profitable, safe and efficient operation of the company’s owned commercial vehicles. The role includes vehicle planning, driver management, route monitoring, maintenance control, fuel management, documentation, trip profitability and daily reporting. The Fleet Manager will be personally accountable for ensuring maximum vehicle utilisation, minimum operating cost, timely deliveries and strict control over drivers, fuel, repairs, advances and vehicle documents. Key Responsibilities 1. Vehicle Planning and Utilisation Plan and deploy every vehicle to achieve maximum monthly running and revenue. Coordinate with the Traffic, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams for availability of profitable loads. Minimise vehicle idle time, empty running and unnecessary detention. Arrange suitable return loads before or immediately after delivery. Ensure vehicles are not dispatched on commercially unviable trips without written approval. Maintain a daily availability and placement plan for all vehicles. Prioritise profitable movement on approved routes, including Delhi NCR, Gujarat, Vapi and Mumbai sectors. 2. Driver Management Recruit, verify and manage qualified heavy-commercial-vehicle drivers. Verify driving licence, Aadhaar, address, police verification, references and previous employment before deployment. Conduct daily communication with every driver regarding location, vehicle condition, delivery status and next movement. Ensure drivers follow assigned routes, scheduled halts and company instructions. Monitor driver attendance, conduct, driving discipline and performance. Prevent unauthorised vehicle use, route deviation, overloading and carrying of unauthorised goods or passengers. Enforce zero tolerance for alcohol, drugs, theft, misbehaviour and unsafe driving. Arrange replacement drivers promptly to avoid vehicle idling. Recommend driver incentives or disciplinary action based on measurable performance. 3. Trip and Route Monitoring Monitor every vehicle through GPS, SIM-based tracking, toll records and direct driver communication. Ensure a tracking link is generated and shared for every dispatched vehicle. Track loading, departure, transit, arrival, unloading and POD collection. Immediately escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, route deviations or customer-related issues. Ensure drivers complete the required daily running while complying with road-safety and mandatory-rest requirements. Maintain accurate estimated and actual delivery timelines. Coordinate with customers, branches and unloading locations for timely vehicle release. 4. Fuel and Mileage Control Record fuel issued and purchased vehicle-wise and trip-wise. Monitor mileage against the prescribed vehicle benchmark. Cross-check fuel consumption with kilometres travelled, GPS records, load weight and route conditions. Prevent fuel theft, false bills, unauthorised refuelling and excess consumption. Investigate every case of mileage below the approved benchmark. Maintain fuel-card, cash-fuel and diesel-advance records. Submit a weekly vehicle-wise mileage and fuel-variance report. 5. Maintenance and Breakdown Management Maintain preventive-maintenance schedules for every vehicle. Ensure timely servicing, lubrication, tyre inspection, brake inspection and replacement of essential parts. Conduct or arrange pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Maintain vehicle-wise repair and maintenance history. Obtain estimates and approval before undertaking major repairs. Verify repair bills, replaced parts and workshop work before payment approval. Keep breakdown time and repair expenses under strict control. Maintain relationships with reliable workshops, mechanics, tyre vendors and roadside-assistance providers. Ensure spare tyres, tools, safety equipment and essential emergency items are available in every vehicle. 6. Tyre Management Maintain a tyre register containing tyre number, make, purchase date, fitting date, vehicle position and kilometres covered. Monitor tyre rotation, alignment, air pressure, retreading and replacement. Investigate premature tyre failure and driver negligence. Control tyre inventory and disposal of scrap tyres. Submit a monthly tyre-cost and tyre-performance report. 7. Documentation and Legal Compliance Ensure that the following documents remain valid and available:
 Registration Certificate Fitness Certificate National and state permits Insurance Pollution Under Control Certificate Road tax FASTag Driver’s licence E-way bill and consignment documents Any other statutory transport documents Maintain a document-expiry calendar and initiate renewals well in advance. Ensure compliance with applicable transport, road-safety and motor-vehicle regulations. Maintain records of challans, accidents, insurance claims and legal matters. Prevent dispatch of any vehicle or driver with expired or incomplete documents. 8. Trip Expenses and Advance Control Prepare and approve trip-expense estimates according to route, distance, tolls, fuel and applicable allowances. Record all advances issued to drivers. Ensure that every driver submits bills and settles the previous trip advance before receiving a new advance, except with written approval. Verify tolls, fuel bills, repair bills, loading/unloading expenses and other trip expenses. Prevent duplicate, inflated, unsupported or unauthorised claims. Submit completed trip sheets and supporting documents to Accounts within the prescribed timeline. 9. Delivery and POD Control Ensure safe and timely delivery of every consignment. Instruct drivers to obtain a properly signed and stamped Proof of Delivery. Ensure PODs are collected and submitted within 15 days of delivery or within the customer’s prescribed timeline. Maintain a daily pending-POD report. Coordinate with drivers, branches and customers to recover pending PODs. Immediately report shortages, damages, remarks, refusal of delivery or detention. Hand over PODs and trip documents to the ERP/Billing team against acknowledgement. 10. Accident and Emergency Management Respond immediately to accidents, breakdowns, theft, cargo damage and other emergencies. Arrange police intimation, photographs, survey, towing, repairs and alternate vehicles wherever required. Inform management, the customer, insurer and concerned authorities without delay. Protect the cargo and prevent further loss after an incident. Maintain complete accident and insurance-claim documentation. Conduct an internal review and recommend preventive measures after every major incident. 11. Cost and Profitability Control Prepare a vehicle-wise and trip-wise profitability statement. Monitor the following costs:
 Fuel Driver salary and allowance Toll and route expenses Repairs and maintenance Tyres Insurance and permits Detention and penalties EMI and depreciation, where applicable Empty-running cost Compare expected revenue with the complete trip cost before deployment. Identify loss-making vehicles, routes, customers and operating practices. Recommend measures to improve fleet profitability and asset utilisation. Work with the Commercial Manager to determine minimum viable freight for each route. Mandatory Daily Report The Fleet Manager must submit a written daily report every evening containing: Vehicle number Driver name and contact number LR/GR number Customer name Origin and destination Loading date Current vehicle location Current trip status Expected delivery date Actual delivery status POD status Advance paid Fuel purchased Kilometres travelled Mileage achieved Freight revenue Trip expenses Vehicle availability Breakdown or maintenance status Next-load planning Issues requiring management attention Failure to submit the daily report without valid authorisation may be treated as failure to perform assigned duties and may affect attendance and performance evaluation. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be evaluated on: Vehicle utilisation percentage Loaded kilometres versus empty kilometres Monthly revenue per vehicle Trip-wise and vehicle-wise profitability Fuel efficiency and mileage variance On-time pickup and delivery percentage Average vehicle idle time Return-load arrangement Maintenance cost per kilometre Number and duration of breakdowns Tyre life and tyre cost per kilometre Driver retention and discipline Accident and challan frequency Timely settlement of driver advances Percentage of PODs received within 15 days Accuracy and punctuality of daily reports Compliance with documentation and renewal deadlines Required Qualifications and Experience Graduate or diploma holder; transport or automobile qualification preferred. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience managing commercial trucks or heavy vehicles. Practical knowledge of 12-wheel, 14/15-wheel and multi-axle vehicles is preferred. Strong understanding of diesel consumption, mileage, tyres, repairs, permits, tolls and trip expenses. Experience managing drivers and resolving on-road operational issues. Knowledge of major transport routes, especially Delhi NCR, Gujarat and Maharashtra. Comfortable using GPS systems, WhatsApp, email, Excel and transport ERP software. Ability to prepare daily MIS and vehicle-wise profitability reports. Willingness to remain available for urgent fleet matters outside normal working hours. Essential Skills Strong leadership and driver-handling ability High level of honesty and accountability Commercial and cost-control mindset Knowledge of vehicle maintenance Route and load-planning ability Negotiation and vendor-management skills Crisis-management capability Accurate documentation and reporting Basic Excel and ERP proficiency Clear written and verbal communication Behavioural Expectations The Fleet Manager must: Protect company vehicles, cargo, money and reputation. Maintain complete transparency in fuel, repairs, advances and vendor dealings. Never accept commissions or personal benefits from workshops, fuel stations, drivers or vendors. Avoid providing false vehicle locations, fabricated reports or incorrect expense information. Immediately disclose accidents, cargo damage, theft, breakdowns and financial irregularities. Maintain confidentiality of company rates, customers and operational information. Follow management instructions and cooperate with all departments. Any fraud, deliberate misreporting, fuel theft, unauthorised expense, document manipulation or concealment of material information may result in disciplinary action, including termination and recovery of losses as permitted by law. Compensation Salary will be based on experience, operational knowledge and interview performance. A performance-linked incentive may be offered against measurable improvements in fleet utilisation, mileage, cost control, POD compliance and profitability. Application Details Interested candidates may submit their CV along with details of: Current and expected salary Notice period Commercial fleet size previously managed Types of vehicles handled Routes managed Experience with GPS, ERP and fleet MIS References from previous employers Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd.

title: Lead Engineer - Engineering Planner & Scheduler
description:
Job Description Summary The Lead Engineering Planner will be responsible for developing, integrating, and maintaining high-quality engineering project schedules across HDNU Gas Power Engineering. This role supports proposal, contract, and execution phases, ensuring schedule rigor, transparency, and alignment with business objectives. The position plays a key role in improving planning maturity, schedule quality, and delivery performance across projects and portfolios. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Engineering & Project Scheduling Develop, release, and maintain complex, integrated engineering project schedules using Primavera P6, ensuring alignment with scope, execution strategy, and contractual requirements. Execute project schedules for assigned Gas Power Business scopes (including Gas Turbine/Generator/Steam Turbine/HRSG and Balance of Plant engineering), ensuring schedule integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Convert proposal and tender schedules into fully integrated contract schedules, adjusting activity logic, durations, and sequencing based on finalized engineering scope. Prepare and manage Tender Time Schedules (TTS), Overall Time Schedules (OTS), Master Time Schedules (MTS), System Time Schedules (STS), and portfolio-level schedules as required. Establish and maintain baseline schedules, manage revisions (Rebaseline), and control schedule changes through formal change logs. Proposal & Contract Support Partner with ITO and Proposal teams to define engineering support requirements, develop schedule assumptions, scope matrices, and delivery sequences. Participate in deviation and clarification meetings, supporting schedule alignment during proposal and contract finalization. Provide schedule inputs for contract negotiations and support preparation of contract documentation. Schedule Control & Performance Monitoring Monitor, update, and control project schedules based on engineering progress inputs (including PLM interfaces). Identify and analyze critical and near-critical paths, float consumption, and schedule risks; proactively recommend mitigation and recovery actions. Evaluate schedule impacts resulting from customer-requested scope changes and support Extension of Time (EOT) and as-impacted schedule analyses. Perform micro-planning for critical or delayed work packages and develop what-if scenarios to support recovery planning. Reporting, Analytics & Communication Prepare and release project dashboards, KPIs, progress reports, and management presentations for steering committees and senior leadership. Develop and maintain S-Curves, progress measurement systems (Earned value management), and forecast completion metrics for engineering scopes. Issue weekly look-ahead schedules, monthly progress reports, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance reports. Track and report engineering and customer deliverable milestones (LD). Clearly communicate schedule status, risks, and recovery plans to cross-functional stakeholders. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Partner with senior engineering planners to define and continuously improve planning standards, templates, and data management practices. Collaborate across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and external vendors to maintain schedule rigor and execution discipline. Capture lessons learned and planning best practices during project close-out to support continuous improvement across HDNU Gas Power Engineering. Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Mechanical or Electrical engineering. Experience in Engineering Planning, Project Planning, or Equipment Planning within complex industrial or EPC environments. Strong hands-on experience with Primavera P6 scheduling and reporting. Desired Characteristics Demonstrated leadership in planning, scheduling, and cross-functional coordination. Proven expertise in baseline management, float analysis, schedule optimization, and risk- based planning. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex schedule data into actionable insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident presenting to senior leadership and customers. High energy, self-starter mindset with a consistent track record of delivery and execution excellence. Experience supporting proposal, contract, and execution phases in large-scale power or industrial projects. Demonstrated behaviors aligned with The Vernova Way. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

description:
Job Summary Yashuss Unlimited, a premier provider of technology solutions and services, is seeking a highly adept Support Executive to deliver mission-critical assistance throughout the post-implementation lifecycle of enterprise applications.

 The ideal candidate will leverage profound knowledge of cloud-based ecosystems to resolve technical impediments expeditiously, ensuring operational continuity and maximizing ROI for clients in dynamic business environments.

 Post-Implementation Support:- 
 Deliver sustained technical sustenance to clients post-deployment, orchestrating system diagnostics to uphold optimal performance and mitigate disruptions in production environments.

 Technical Issue Resolution:- 
 Field and triage client escalations pertaining to application architecture, integration protocols, and operational workflows via multichannel support vectors.

 User Assistance and Training:- 
 Facilitate resolution of access governance issues, parametric configurations, and process orchestration queries, ensuring compliance with security postures and data integrity standards.

 Author comprehensive repositories of recurrent anomalies, resolution algorithms, and FAQs to fortify an enterprise-grade knowledge management system.
 Iteratively refine user documentation suites and diagnostic playbooks in response to emergent patterns or evolutionary application enhancements.
 Maintain immutable audit trails of support interactions, leveraging metadata for analytics-driven insights into service efficacy.
 Client Relationship Management:- 
 Sustain transparent, protocol-driven dialogues with stakeholders, provisioning real-time status telemetry on incident lifecycles to engender trust.
 Champion client delight via proactive outreach, sentiment analysis, and preemptive remediation strategies tailored to individual deployment profiles.
 Cultivate enduring partnerships by synthesizing client telemetry into actionable intelligence, reinforcing organizational loyalty and advocacy.
 Application Monitoring and Feedback:- 
 Institute vigilant oversight of post-deployment application metrics using monitoring tools to preemptively flag deviations and orchestrate corrective interventions.
 Aggregate and synthesize client feedback vectors on solution efficacy, distilling insights into enhancement roadmaps for iterative product evolution.
 Synergize with deployment architects to refine implementation blueprints, infusing support-derived heuristics to optimize future rollout cadences.
 Collaboration with Implementation and Development Teams:-

 Channel client-derived intelligence upstream, informing architectural refinements, feature augmentations, and patch deployments in agile development cycles. Requirements:

 Proven track record in supporting cloud-native applications (e.g., Zoho Suite, CRM/ERP platforms like Salesforce or SAP), including integration troubleshooting and performance tuning.
 Technical Skills:- 
 Profound proficiency in diagnostic tools and methodologies for resolving issues in distributed systems, APIs, and database interactions.
 Mastery of ticketing and CRM systems (e.g., Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Freshdesk) for incident management and workflow automation.
 Familiarity with foundational business process modeling in domains such as CRM, sales automation, marketing orchestration, and ERP integrations.
 Competence in scripting basics (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of routine diagnostics and report generation.
 Soft Skills:- 
 Exemplary communication prowess, adept at demystifying complex technical constructs for non-technical audiences while maintaining precision.
 Robust interpersonal acumen to navigate stakeholder dynamics and foster collaborative resolutions in high-stakes scenarios.
 Acute problem-solving aptitude, enabling efficient multitasking across concurrent support vectors in fast-evolving tech landscapes.
 Resilience and adaptability to thrive in a 24/7 support paradigm, with a commitment to continuous learning in emerging technologies.

 Prior exposure to AI-assisted support tools for predictive issue detection and automated resolutions.

About the Role: We re expanding our Customer Success team at Z Tok with 10+ open positions. We are building India s first network CRM for conversational commerce, and your job is to ensure our clients actually adopt and see massive value from our Agentic AI on WhatsApp Business. As part of the Customer Success team at ZoTok, you will play a critical role in ensuring our clients adopt, implement and derive maximum value from our platform. This is not a passive support role - you are expected to own accounts end to end, drive technical delivery, manage stakeholders, and grow revenue through upsells and expansions. We are hiring across multiple sub-roles within Customer Success - from onboarding and activation to key account management and technical project delivery. Each role requires a combination of technical aptitude, commercial instinct and strong client relationship skills. 
 The Basics: Experience: 2 to 10 years Early joiners preferred. Roles & Responsibilities Onboarding & Implementation Own end-to-end client onboarding - from contract closure to first bill generation and successful product adoption. Understand client business requirements and configure, customize and integrate ZoTok within their existing systems. Manage technical project delivery including timelines, milestones and go-live planning. Work with integration tools including Postman, APIs and ERP connectors to ensure seamless setup. Account Management & Revenue Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts - building strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers. Monitor account health scores, product usage and adoption metrics using Odoo and internal CRM tools. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities post-onboarding and drive revenue expansion. Own and manage revenue responsibility for assigned accounts - retention and growth are your KPIs. Sell Done-for-You models where you directly drive business outcomes for clients using ZoTok. Technical & Product Conduct product demonstrations tailored to client-specific needs and industry workflows. Perform QA and UAT validation during implementation to ensure product is configured correctly. Gather and document client requirements using BA methodologies - BRDs, user stories and process maps. Collaborate with internal Tech, Product and Integration teams to resolve client issues promptly. Stakeholder Management Manage internal pushback from client-side blockers and influencers who fear automation - convince them ZoTok makes their work easier. Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders and present performance reports. Provide training to client teams to ensure they are fully equipped to use ZoTok independently. Serve as a trusted advisor - not just a support contact - throughout the client journey. What are we looking for Experience & Background 2-10 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Technical Project Delivery or similar roles in IT/SaaS industry. Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Odoo or similar is a strong advantage. Background in technical implementation, SaaS onboarding or BA roles is highly preferred. Working experience in Distribution, Supply Chain or B2B Commerce industries is a plus. Bachelors degree mandatory - negotiable for candidates with strong relevant experience. Technical Skills Familiarity with Postman, REST APIs and integration workflows. Experience with QA processes, UAT and product testing. Proficiency in CRM tools - Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot or similar. Basic understanding of ERP workflows - SAP, Tally, Zoho or similar. Ability to read and interpret API documentation and integration specs. Soft Skills & Mindset Commercial Instinct - you dont just support clients, you spot expansion opportunities and drive upsells naturally. Stakeholder Management - you can hold a room, manage pushback and get buy-in from skeptical decision-makers. Ownership Mindset - you drive tasks to completion without being told and think proactively about what comes next. Communication - excellent verbal and written communication with clients, leadership and internal teams. Adaptability - ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. 
 What matters more than the resume: Stakeholder Management & Persuasion: You can hold a room and manage pushback from insecure internal influencers who fear automation. Technical - Postman, REST APIs, QA/UAT, CRM tools (Salesforce, Odoo), ERP background (SAP, Tally, Zoho) - advantage. Domain - Supply chain, distribution, B2B commerce or SaaS implementation background - strongly preferred. Mindset - Commercial instinct, ownership, stakeholder management and hunger to make clients genuinely successful. Commercial Instinct: You dont just support clients; you spot expansion opportunities and naturally drive upsells post-onboarding. Industry & SaaS Context: Deep familiarity with supply chain, distribution, or B2B SaaS workflows to guide clients. 
 Why Join ZoTok At ZoTok, you wont be managing accounts - you will be shaping how Indias businesses operate on WhatsApp. Youll work at the intersection of AI, commerce and technology, building something that has never been done before in India. 
 Be part of Indias first Network CRM for conversational commerce - a category-defining product. Work directly with Brands, Distributors and Retailers across Indias $1 trillion+ General Trade ecosystem. Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Management and B2B SaaS - skills that compound over time. Fast-paced, ownership-driven culture where your impact is visible and rewarded. Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale rapidly across India and globally. ZoTok occupies a niche market with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary - redefining Conversational Commerce in India and beyond. title: Mainframe MVS / z/OS System Administrator
description:
Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. 
 The Role As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients - which means some of the biggest in the world.
 
There s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage z/OS system programming initiatives Design resilient and scalable mainframe infrastructure Handle upgrades, migrations, and SMP/E maintenance Manage core components: JES, storage, networking Support CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ subsystems Drive automation, performance, and capacity optimization Resolve critical incidents and perform root cause analysis Ensure security, compliance, and SLA adherence Support disaster recovery and monitoring integration Collaborate with teams, vendors, and stakeholders Mentor team members and drive modernization efforts 
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times Yes! But you ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
 
Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. 
 Who You Are You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience 7+ Yrs Expertise in IBM z/OS system programming with strong knowledge of z/OS internals and architecture Proficiency in SMP/E installation, maintenance, and upgrade management Hands-on experience with JES2/JES3 administration and operations In-depth understanding of mainframe storage (DASD, DFSMS, HSM) and networking (TCP/IP, VTAM) Enterprise subsystem support for CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ Skills in performance tuning, capacity planning, dump analysis, and advanced problem determination Strong root cause analysis capability for critical incidents Experience with automation and scheduling tools on z/OS Expertise in system upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives Knowledge of security administration and compliance management on z/OS Familiarity with disaster recovery and high availability concepts Experience with monitoring and observability tools for mainframe environments Proven ability in production support within SLA-driven environments Understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes Scripting skills using Shell, REXX, or CLIST Experience in vendor coordination and defect resolution Demonstrated leadership in enterprise mainframe operations Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Strong expertise in IBM z/OS architecture design and engineering, including knowledge of Parallel Sysplex and GDPS Hands-on experience with IBM Tivoli, OMEGAMON, NetView, and System Automation tools Proven capability in mainframe automation, self-healing platform implementation, and AIOps-driven observability integration Familiarity with DevOps practices for mainframe environments and hybrid cloud integration Knowledge of z/OS security products such as RACF, ACF2, and Top Secret Experience in capacity forecasting and enterprise optimization strategies Exposure to modernization and transformation programs and defining enterprise operational standards Experience with modern automation frameworks such as Ansible and Zowe Understanding of mainframe API enablement and integration technologies Knowledge of compliance, audit frameworks, and ITIL-based service management practices Cross-platform infrastructure integration experience Strong mentoring, technical leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities Focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives 
 Being You The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That s The Kyndryl Way. 
 What You Can Expect Your career with us isn t just a job-it s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health-because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
 
From your very first day, you ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won t just contribute-you ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
 
We re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities-from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
 
We want you to thrive here-and we re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact Join us and help shape what s next. Get Referred! title: Account Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced accounting professional to manage daily accounts, Tally entries, invoicing, banking, GST and TDS compliance, financial documentation and management reports. The candidate should independently maintain accurate books and coordinate with management and the companys Chartered Accountant. 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Accounting & Tally Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses and journal entries in Tally. Maintain ledgers, reconcile balances and ensure accurate supporting documents. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, petty cash and expense reimbursements. Complete monthly closing entries, including provisions, accruals and depreciation. 2. Profit & Loss and Financial Reports Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, balance sheet schedules and cash-flow reports. Review income, expenses and margins; highlight unusual entries or cost increases. Prepare reports on outstanding payments, collections, sales, purchases and expenses. Submit accurate monthly MIS reports to management within agreed timelines. 3. GST & TDS Prepare GST workings, reconcile purchase records with GSTR-2B and coordinate return filing. Check GST details on sales and purchase invoices and maintain input tax credit records. Calculate applicable TDS, prepare payment workings and coordinate returns and certificates. Maintain compliance records and follow up with the CA on discrepancies and pending matters. 4. Banking & Payments Perform bank reconciliations and track receipts, payments and bank charges. Prepare vendor payment schedules and banking instructions for authorised approval. Maintain banking documents and coordinate routine queries with banks. Monitor cash and bank balances and report upcoming payment requirements. 5. Invoicing & Commercial Documents Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes as required. Verify invoices against purchase orders, agreed prices, payment terms and delivery records. Prepare or coordinate e-invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans and supporting documents where applicable. Coordinate with sales, purchase and dispatch teams for accurate and timely billing. 6. Receivables, Payables & Documentation Follow up on customer payments and reconcile customer and vendor accounts. Maintain ageing reports and highlight overdue balances. Organise invoices, vouchers, purchase orders, bank records and statutory documents. Provide records and schedules for audits, assessments and CA reviews. Maintain confidentiality and follow company approval procedures. 
 Preferred candidate profile Strong practical knowledge of Tally Prime and MS Excel. Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and monthly accounts closing. Ability to prepare and explain P&L statements and accounting reports. Good attention to detail, communication and follow-up skills. Ability to manage deadlines and work independently. Experience in manufacturing, trading or export businesses is an advantage. Performance Expectations Accurate, up-to-date books with complete supporting documents. Timely monthly closing and management reporting. Regular reconciliation of banks, customers and vendors. Timely compliance preparation and escalation of pending issues. Properly approved payments and prompt reporting of discrepancies.

title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
Were proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. 
 
 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager 
 Location: Bangalore| Experience: 10+ years |Team: 5-8 IT professionals | User base: ~500-person IT organization 
 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. title: Manager, Finance Operations
description:
Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Description: Footer Overall Purpose of The Job The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day-to-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India u2014 booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end booking-to-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds. Oversee high-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release. Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms. Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees. Own the month-end and year-end close for the Finance Operations sub-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger. Prepare and review unit-level and product-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan. Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership. Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs). Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team. Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR-2B mismatches with vendors. Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations. Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross-border settlements. Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection. Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle Key Metrics / Success Measures Timely and accurate operational close: sub-ledger close completed within 4-5 business days of month-end with zero material post-close adjustments. Payment discipline: on-time payment rate of [u2265 98%] and DPO within targeted range. BSP, gateway and agent-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month. Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations. Accurate and timely unit-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence. Job Profile Requirements 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team. Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools. Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage. Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross-border payments). Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes. Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners. Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics. Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles. Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience. Chartered Accountant (Mandatory). Required Languages: Good spoken and written English language skills Travel Requirements: Not applicable / minimal.

title: Manager Workforce Management - Dialer
description:
Position Summary The Operations Dialer Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous optimization of outbound and inbound dialing strategies supporting first-party credit card collections. This role serves as a key liaison between Collections Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics/MIS, Compliance, Technology, clients, and third-party vendors, ensuring that account inventory, staffing, contact strategies, dialer capabilities, and business objectives are aligned to maximize collections performance while maintaining operational and regulatory compliance. The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to act as a subject matter expert in dialer strategy and collections operations, capable of representing the organization in discussions with clients, technology providers, telecommunications vendors, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong experience in first-party credit card collections, understands delinquency-stage strategies and customer segmentation, and has hands-on knowledge of the LiveVox contact center and dialer platform. --- Key Responsibilities Dialer Strategy & Management Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly dialing strategies for first-party credit card collection portfolios. Configure and manage LiveVox campaigns, services, skill groups, dialing modes, account segmentation, and contact strategies. Determine appropriate dialing treatments based on delinquency stage, account risk, customer behavior, historical contactability, payment likelihood, and operational priorities. Optimize predictive, automated, manual, and agent-initiated dialing strategies based on portfolio requirements. Manage account penetration and attempt strategies to balance contact rates, collections performance, customer experience, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate campaign performance throughout the day and make real-time adjustments based on staffing, account inventory, penetration, contact rates, and collection results. Coordinate campaign reruns, prioritization strategies, and reassignment of account inventory when necessary. Identify opportunities to improve contact efficiency while reducing unnecessary or low-value dialing activity. --- Collections Operations Support collection strategies across various stages of delinquency, including early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage credit card collections. title: Senior Manager - Data & Analytics
description:
The Role We are looking for a hands-on leader to own the data, analytics, and AI portfolio end to end - and the team that builds it. You are the single point of accountability between business stakeholders and the analytics organization: gathering and pressure-testing requirements, turning ambiguous problems into a prioritized roadmap, and leading the developers, analysts, and data scientists who deliver scalable, trusted, widely adopted products. This is not a role that manages from a distance. You will be in the requirements sessions, the data model reviews, the SQL, the dashboard design critiques, and the model evaluations - and you will be measured on adoption and business outcomes, not backlog size or model sophistication. What You'll Do Team Leadership & Talent: Lead the team. Manage a talented team of senior and junior developers, analysts, and data scientists - setting direction on best practices, engineering standards, and alignment with team priorities. Develop people. Mentor team members, connecting their personal and professional goals to real career growth; set the standard for rigor and craft. Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements: Be the trusted partner. Serve as the primary interface to the different organizations and run structured discovery to elicit underlying needs, not feature requests. Write requirements that hold up. Translate business questions into testable specs: source systems, grain, metric definitions, SLAs, quality thresholds, and acceptance criteria. Drive a single source of truth for core metrics and arbitrate definitional conflicts. Simplify the complex. Navigate ambiguous, politically loaded problems and distill them into actionable messaging that aligns with business priorities and lands with executives. Prioritization. Roadmap & Datamart Strategy: Own the roadmap. Manage, prioritize, and align data, reporting, and analytics requirements with business needs, overseeing development and implementation. Make trade-offs explicit. Apply a consistent prioritization framework - value, reach, effort, risk, strategic fit - and communicate the rationale transparently, including to stakeholders you deprioritize. Shape strategy at the table. Play a key role in cross-functional committees defining data mart strategy, governance, and policy; invest ahead of demand in capabilities that make future requests cheaper to serve. Visualization & Experience Design: Design for the decision. Set the standard for how analytics is presented - choose the right visual for the question, build a clear hierarchy, and design every dashboard around the decision the user is trying to make rather than the data that happens to be available. Own the design system. Define and enforce visualization standards across the portfolio - chart conventions, color, typography, layout, naming, interaction patterns, and accessibility - so products look and behave consistently and stay maintainable as the team grows. Prototype, test, and prune. Wireframe and iterate with real users before building; validate with usage data and feedback, and retire dashboards that dont drive action. Technical Leadership: Warehouse, BI & Pipelines: Lead technically. Hands-on in advanced SQL on Snowflake, with the credibility to review the teams work rather than take it on faith. Design for scale. Oversee scalable pipelines and workflows that process large, diverse, unstructured datasets with high performance and reliability; automate cleaning, integration, and analysis in SQL and Python. Enable self-service. Champion governed datasets, semantic layers, and intuitive dashboards that let non-technical users answer their own questions - over one-off extracts and bespoke reports. Optimize what exists. Drive innovation in data architecture, dashboard performance, and cost efficiency; champion data quality and accuracy through lineage, testing, and clear ownership. Data Science, AI & Machine Learning: Set the AI agenda. Identify, size, and prioritize the use cases where ML and generative AI create real business value - and say no to the ones that dont. Deliver GenAI experiences. Build generative AI into the analytics stack - natural-language querying, conversational BI, automated insight generation, AI-assisted documentation and discovery. Adoption, Measurement & Communication: Measure what matters. Define success metrics for every product - adoption, time-to-insight, data freshness, decisions enabled, cost - and hold the team accountable to them. Drive adoption and clarity. Lead enablement through documentation, training, and change management; present insights, risks, and trade-offs to audiences from individual engineers to the executive staff. We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bengaluru office in compliance with Everpures policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. What You Bring Experience & Leadership: 15+ years in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or data platform roles, including 4+ years directly managing teams. An advanced degree in statistics, data science, or computer science preferred. Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise data, BI, or analytics portfolio from requirements through production adoption, with evidence of business impact - plus a track record of solving complex problems and using data to influence senior stakeholders. Domain expertise in one or more of: finance, customer, or product. Experience with CRM and ERP datasets strongly preferred. Technical Depth: Advanced SQL - able to write, review, optimize, and debug complex analytical queries independently; deep experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse. Knowledge of Python, including package development and production-quality code standards. Hands-on with enterprise BI and semantic layer tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, ThoughtSpot) and what makes them perform at scale; working knowledge of governance, lineage, observability, and access control. Visualization & Design: Strong data visualization craft - fluent in chart selection, visual hierarchy, and the principles that separate a clear view from a cluttered one. Able to take a dense, ambiguous dataset and present it so an executive understands it in seconds. Genuine design sensibility: layout, whitespace, typography, purposeful color, and accessibility (including colorblind-safe palettes). A portfolio of dashboards or reports you designed is welcome. Experience establishing visualization standards or a design system across a BI portfolio, and comfort wireframing and iterating with users. Familiarity with UX principles and design tools such as Figma is a plus. Business & Communication Skill: Sophisticated stakeholder management: build consensus across functions, hold a position under pressure, and say no without damaging the relationship. Connect data and AI investments to business outcomes and articulate ROI in the language of the function being served. Excellent written and verbal communication - equally capable of a one-page decision memo and an executive presentation.

Role & responsibilities We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Logistics Assistant to support our UAE operations from our Chennai office. The role will primarily focus on logistics documentation, shipment coordination, data management, and communication with the UAE-based logistics and operations teams . 
 The successful candidate will ensure that all logistics and shipment-related documentation is prepared accurately and on time, while maintaining proper records and providing timely administrative support to the UAE operations. Update shipment and logistics information in ERP/HRMS/Logistics systems or relevant databases . Follow up on shipment status, delivery documentation, and pending documents with relevant stakeholders. Support the UAE team with document retrieval, data entry, reporting, and other logistics-related administrative activities. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and other MS Office applications . ERP/Logistics software knowledge will be an advantage. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to communicate effectively with teams in India and the UAE. Good written and spoken English. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Strong organizational and record-management skills. Ability to work independently while coordinating with a remote UAE team. 
 Preferred Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field . 1 to 3 years of experience in logistics documentation, shipping coordination, supply chain administration, or a similar role. Experience handling documentation for international shipments/import-export will be preferred. Experience supporting GCC/UAE operations will be an added advantage. Candidates with experience in the chemical distribution, trading, or industrial products sector will be preferred. 
 Important Note This position will be based in the Chennai office and will support the UAE region remotely . title: Regulatory Manager
description:
Role Summary Reporting to the Regional Regulatory Head, the Regulatory Manager, India & Middle East is responsible for defining and implementing regulatory strategies that enable compliant, timely and sustainable business growth across India and Middle East markets. The role serves as the primary regulatory business partner and regulatory voice for the IME organization. It influences portfolio, innovation, market-entry, product-classification and launch decisions by translating complex regulatory requirements into clear business options, risk assessments and actionable recommendations. The Regulatory Manager oversees a large and diverse product portfolio, balancing the operational demands of high-volume categories, particularly cosmetics, with the technical complexity and higher regulatory risk associated with OTC products, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products and electrical products. This position works closely with Commercial, Marketing, R&D, Quality, Legal, Supply Chain, Product Development and Global Regulatory Affairs to establish priorities, resolve regulatory barriers and balance compliance, business value, resource requirements and speed to market. It also leads interactions with distributors, consultants, agencies and, where appropriate, regulatory authorities. Success in this role requires a combination of regulatory leadership, sound technical judgment, portfolio management, execution discipline, cultural awareness and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority. Strategy and Functional Expertise Develops and implements regulatory strategies that support compliant and sustainable business growth across India and the Middle East. Provides regulatory feasibility assessments for new products, market expansion, product classifications, claims and portfolio changes. Balances regulatory compliance, business risk and speed to market, particularly across cosmetics, OTC products, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products and electrical products. Translates complex regulatory requirements into clear business options and actionable recommendations. Applies sound regulatory judgment in ambiguous situations and identifies when technical or senior-level escalation is required. Monitors regulatory developments and assesses their potential impact on products, launches and business continuity. Maintains accurate regulatory documentation, performance metrics and management reporting. Promotes standardized, risk-based and efficient regulatory processes for a high-volume, multicategory portfolio. Leadership and Influence Acts as the regulatory voice and trusted business partner for India and Middle East leadership. Influences senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority. Leads discussions involving regulatory risk, portfolio priorities, market entry, product classification and speed-to-market decisions. Provides clear direction, removes obstacles and holds the regulatory team and stakeholders accountable for agreed deliverables. Develops team capability through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing and stretch assignments. Builds effective relationships across Commercial, Marketing, R&D, Quality, Legal, Supply Chain, Product Development and Global Regulatory Affairs. Communicates complex issues clearly and persuasively, adapting the message to technical and nontechnical audiences. Demonstrates openness, curiosity and a willingness to listen to different perspectives, challenge assumptions and learn from local-market expertise. Promotes collaboration, inclusion and trust across organizational, geographic and cultural boundaries. Program Development / Project Management Leads regulatory programs and projects from strategy through implementation, ensuring clear scope, priorities, ownership and timelines. Manages multiple registrations, renewals, amendments, launches and regulatory-change initiatives simultaneously. Prioritizes projects according to regulatory risk, business impact, urgency and resource requirements. Monitors project progress, performance, deadlines, dependencies and spending. Anticipates regulatory barriers and coordinates timely actions to resolve issues. Works cross-functionally to identify market and distributor requirements and convert them into executable plans. Establishes practical governance, metrics and reporting to support timely decisions and stakeholder visibility. Manages consultants, agencies and other external partners, ensuring quality, confidentiality, accountability and effective use of resources. Identifies opportunities to simplify processes, reduce rework and improve regulatory productivity. Impact / Reach Supports a diverse, high-volume portfolio across India and multiple Middle East markets. Influences strategic and operational decisions involving regulated products, market access, launches and business continuity. Operates across country, regional and global teams, connecting local regulatory requirements with broader business priorities. Builds strong internal and external partnerships with business leaders, distributors, consultants, agencies and regulatory authorities. Demonstrates agility and cultural awareness when working across different markets, regulatory systems and business practices. Works openly and effectively in multicultural environments, respecting local perspectives while maintaining global standards. Creates clarity and alignment in complex situations where regulatory, commercial, technical and supply considerations may compete. Adjusts communication style, content and approach to meet the needs of different cultures, functions and levels of seniority. Education and Experience University degree from an accredited institution in pharmacy, chemistry, life sciences, engineering, regulatory affairs or another relevant technical field. Significant progressive experience in Regulatory Affairs within consumer health, consumer products or another multicategory regulated environment. Demonstrated experience supporting India, Middle East, GCC markets or similarly complex and diverse regulatory environments. Broad regulatory knowledge across at least two relevant categories, such as cosmetics, OTC medicines, medical devices, dietary supplements, household products, consumer products or electrical products. Experience managing high-volume portfolios and technically complex or ambiguous regulatory matters. Previous supervisory, people-management or team-lead experience. Experience working with distributors, consultants, agencies and regulatory authorities. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages relevant to India and Middle East are advantageous. Experience working successfully with geographically dispersed and multicultural teams. Skills and Competencies Strong strategic thinking, regulatory judgment and business acumen. Results-oriented, action-oriented and accountable for delivery. Ability to make timely, high-quality decisions with incomplete or changing information. Excellent prioritization and portfolio-management capabilities. Strong project and program-management skills. Excellent verbal, written, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to explain complex regulatory matters clearly, concisely and persuasively. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Open-minded, curious and willing to explore alternative regulatory pathways and solutions. Comfortable asking questions, seeking different perspectives and constructively challenging established approaches. Culturally aware, adaptable and genuinely open to working with diverse teams, markets and ways of doing business. Strong collaboration, relationship-building and conflict-resolution skills. High attention to detail, organization, accuracy and confidentiality. Resilient and effective in complex, ambiguous and rapidly changing environments. Committed to continuous learning, process improvement and practical innovation.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Anchanto | Job Description PBU Delivery & Agile Operations Manager - OMS Location: Pune, India | Reports to: Product Business Unit Head | Experience: 6+ Years | Type: Full time, Work from Office About the Role Anchanto is a global enterprise-grade B2B SaaS company. We provide cloud software for brands, retailers, and logistics providers to manage orders, inventory, marketplaces, fulfilment, parcel tracking, and omnichannel commerce. As Anchanto evolves toward integrated Product Business Units (PBUs), we need a leader who can run the delivery operating system of a business unit. This role combines multi-pod Scrum leadership, program delivery, resource and capacity planning, financial visibility, operational governance, and PBU administration. This is not a ceremony-only Scrum Master role. The person is expected to independently create structure, maintain a single view of all commitments, challenge unrealistic plans, hold senior stakeholders accountable, and ensure work gets delivered with speed, predictability, and quality. The role requires a strong presence with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Customer Delivery, Support, and the PBU Head. Why This Role Exists The PBU model brings Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Implementation, and Support closer together around a single product outcome. To make this model work, the PBU needs one owner for delivery rhythm, portfolio visibility, resource loading, risk management, operational discipline, and leadership reporting. This role exists to ensure that the PBU does not depend on fragmented trackers, informal follow-ups, or late escalations. What You Will Own The role owns nine areas. The expectation across all of them is the same: strong ownership, data over opinion, early visibility of risk, clear accountability, and reliable execution. Multi-pod Scrum and Agile delivery management Manage approximately 6 to 10 active Scrum teams or delivery pods in parallel, with the ability to scale the operating cadence as the PBU grows. Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily Scrum, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums without creating unnecessary ceremony. Ensure every pod has a clear sprint goal, ready backlog, acceptance criteria, realistic capacity plan, visible dependencies, and agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Monitor and improve commitment reliability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, scope churn, spillover, defect leakage, escaped defects, and release predictability. Improve velocity and flow sustainably without compromising quality or using story points as an individual productivity measure.
