title: Fleet Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FLEET MANAGER Company: Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd.
 Industry: Transportation and Logistics
 Department: Fleet Operations
 Reporting To: Head of Department / Director
 Location: Delhi NCR
 Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company Prashar Road Carriers Pvt. Ltd. is an established logistics company operating since 1993. The company provides Full Truck Load, Part Truck Load, local transportation, warehousing, air, rail and express cargo services across India. Job Summary The Fleet Manager will be responsible for the profitable, safe and efficient operation of the company’s owned commercial vehicles. The role includes vehicle planning, driver management, route monitoring, maintenance control, fuel management, documentation, trip profitability and daily reporting. The Fleet Manager will be personally accountable for ensuring maximum vehicle utilisation, minimum operating cost, timely deliveries and strict control over drivers, fuel, repairs, advances and vehicle documents. Key Responsibilities 1. Vehicle Planning and Utilisation Plan and deploy every vehicle to achieve maximum monthly running and revenue. Coordinate with the Traffic, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams for availability of profitable loads. Minimise vehicle idle time, empty running and unnecessary detention. Arrange suitable return loads before or immediately after delivery. Ensure vehicles are not dispatched on commercially unviable trips without written approval. Maintain a daily availability and placement plan for all vehicles. Prioritise profitable movement on approved routes, including Delhi NCR, Gujarat, Vapi and Mumbai sectors. 2. Driver Management Recruit, verify and manage qualified heavy-commercial-vehicle drivers. Verify driving licence, Aadhaar, address, police verification, references and previous employment before deployment. Conduct daily communication with every driver regarding location, vehicle condition, delivery status and next movement. Ensure drivers follow assigned routes, scheduled halts and company instructions. Monitor driver attendance, conduct, driving discipline and performance. Prevent unauthorised vehicle use, route deviation, overloading and carrying of unauthorised goods or passengers. Enforce zero tolerance for alcohol, drugs, theft, misbehaviour and unsafe driving. Arrange replacement drivers promptly to avoid vehicle idling. Recommend driver incentives or disciplinary action based on measurable performance. 3. Trip and Route Monitoring Monitor every vehicle through GPS, SIM-based tracking, toll records and direct driver communication. Ensure a tracking link is generated and shared for every dispatched vehicle. Track loading, departure, transit, arrival, unloading and POD collection. Immediately escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, route deviations or customer-related issues. Ensure drivers complete the required daily running while complying with road-safety and mandatory-rest requirements. Maintain accurate estimated and actual delivery timelines. Coordinate with customers, branches and unloading locations for timely vehicle release. 4. Fuel and Mileage Control Record fuel issued and purchased vehicle-wise and trip-wise. Monitor mileage against the prescribed vehicle benchmark. Cross-check fuel consumption with kilometres travelled, GPS records, load weight and route conditions. Prevent fuel theft, false bills, unauthorised refuelling and excess consumption. Investigate every case of mileage below the approved benchmark. Maintain fuel-card, cash-fuel and diesel-advance records. Submit a weekly vehicle-wise mileage and fuel-variance report. 5. Maintenance and Breakdown Management Maintain preventive-maintenance schedules for every vehicle. Ensure timely servicing, lubrication, tyre inspection, brake inspection and replacement of essential parts. Conduct or arrange pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Maintain vehicle-wise repair and maintenance history. Obtain estimates and approval before undertaking major repairs. Verify repair bills, replaced parts and workshop work before payment approval. Keep breakdown time and repair expenses under strict control. Maintain relationships with reliable workshops, mechanics, tyre vendors and roadside-assistance providers. Ensure spare tyres, tools, safety equipment and essential emergency items are available in every vehicle. 6. Tyre Management Maintain a tyre register containing tyre number, make, purchase date, fitting date, vehicle position and kilometres covered. Monitor tyre rotation, alignment, air pressure, retreading and replacement. Investigate premature tyre failure and driver negligence. Control tyre inventory and disposal of scrap tyres. Submit a monthly tyre-cost and tyre-performance report. 7. Documentation and Legal Compliance Ensure that the following documents remain valid and available:
 Registration Certificate Fitness Certificate National and state permits Insurance Pollution Under Control Certificate Road tax FASTag Driver’s licence E-way bill and consignment documents Any other statutory transport documents Maintain a document-expiry calendar and initiate renewals well in advance. Ensure compliance with applicable transport, road-safety and motor-vehicle regulations. Maintain records of challans, accidents, insurance claims and legal matters. Prevent dispatch of any vehicle or driver with expired or incomplete documents. 8. Trip Expenses and Advance Control Prepare and approve trip-expense estimates according to route, distance, tolls, fuel and applicable allowances. Record all advances issued to drivers. Ensure that every driver submits bills and settles the previous trip advance before receiving a new advance, except with written approval. Verify tolls, fuel bills, repair bills, loading/unloading expenses and other trip expenses. Prevent duplicate, inflated, unsupported or unauthorised claims. Submit completed trip sheets and supporting documents to Accounts within the prescribed timeline. 9. Delivery and POD Control Ensure safe and timely delivery of every consignment. Instruct drivers to obtain a properly signed and stamped Proof of Delivery. Ensure PODs are collected and submitted within 15 days of delivery or within the customer’s prescribed timeline. Maintain a daily pending-POD report. Coordinate with drivers, branches and customers to recover pending PODs. Immediately report shortages, damages, remarks, refusal of delivery or detention. Hand over PODs and trip documents to the ERP/Billing team against acknowledgement. 10. Accident and Emergency Management Respond immediately to accidents, breakdowns, theft, cargo damage and other emergencies. Arrange police intimation, photographs, survey, towing, repairs and alternate vehicles wherever required. Inform management, the customer, insurer and concerned authorities without delay. Protect the cargo and prevent further loss after an incident. Maintain complete accident and insurance-claim documentation. Conduct an internal review and recommend preventive measures after every major incident. 11. Cost and Profitability Control Prepare a vehicle-wise and trip-wise profitability statement. Monitor the following costs:
 Fuel Driver salary and allowance Toll and route expenses Repairs and maintenance Tyres Insurance and permits Detention and penalties EMI and depreciation, where applicable Empty-running cost Compare expected revenue with the complete trip cost before deployment. Identify loss-making vehicles, routes, customers and operating practices. Recommend measures to improve fleet profitability and asset utilisation. Work with the Commercial Manager to determine minimum viable freight for each route. Mandatory Daily Report The Fleet Manager must submit a written daily report every evening containing: Vehicle number Driver name and contact number LR/GR number Customer name Origin and destination Loading date Current vehicle location Current trip status Expected delivery date Actual delivery status POD status Advance paid Fuel purchased Kilometres travelled Mileage achieved Freight revenue Trip expenses Vehicle availability Breakdown or maintenance status Next-load planning Issues requiring management attention Failure to submit the daily report without valid authorisation may be treated as failure to perform assigned duties and may affect attendance and performance evaluation. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be evaluated on: Vehicle utilisation percentage Loaded kilometres versus empty kilometres Monthly revenue per vehicle Trip-wise and vehicle-wise profitability Fuel efficiency and mileage variance On-time pickup and delivery percentage Average vehicle idle time Return-load arrangement Maintenance cost per kilometre Number and duration of breakdowns Tyre life and tyre cost per kilometre Driver retention and discipline Accident and challan frequency Timely settlement of driver advances Percentage of PODs received within 15 days Accuracy and punctuality of daily reports Compliance with documentation and renewal deadlines Required Qualifications and Experience Graduate or diploma holder; transport or automobile qualification preferred. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience managing commercial trucks or heavy vehicles. Practical knowledge of 12-wheel, 14/15-wheel and multi-axle vehicles is preferred. Strong understanding of diesel consumption, mileage, tyres, repairs, permits, tolls and trip expenses. Experience managing drivers and resolving on-road operational issues. Knowledge of major transport routes, especially Delhi NCR, Gujarat and Maharashtra. Comfortable using GPS systems, WhatsApp, email, Excel and transport ERP software. title: Lead Engineer - Engineering Planner & Scheduler
description:
Job Description Summary The Lead Engineering Planner will be responsible for developing, integrating, and maintaining high-quality engineering project schedules across HDNU Gas Power Engineering. This role supports proposal, contract, and execution phases, ensuring schedule rigor, transparency, and alignment with business objectives. The position plays a key role in improving planning maturity, schedule quality, and delivery performance across projects and portfolios. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Engineering & Project Scheduling Develop, release, and maintain complex, integrated engineering project schedules using Primavera P6, ensuring alignment with scope, execution strategy, and contractual requirements. Execute project schedules for assigned Gas Power Business scopes (including Gas Turbine/Generator/Steam Turbine/HRSG and Balance of Plant engineering), ensuring schedule integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Convert proposal and tender schedules into fully integrated contract schedules, adjusting activity logic, durations, and sequencing based on finalized engineering scope. Prepare and manage Tender Time Schedules (TTS), Overall Time Schedules (OTS), Master Time Schedules (MTS), System Time Schedules (STS), and portfolio-level schedules as required. Establish and maintain baseline schedules, manage revisions (Rebaseline), and control schedule changes through formal change logs. Proposal & Contract Support Partner with ITO and Proposal teams to define engineering support requirements, develop schedule assumptions, scope matrices, and delivery sequences. Participate in deviation and clarification meetings, supporting schedule alignment during proposal and contract finalization. Provide schedule inputs for contract negotiations and support preparation of contract documentation. Schedule Control & Performance Monitoring Monitor, update, and control project schedules based on engineering progress inputs (including PLM interfaces). Identify and analyze critical and near-critical paths, float consumption, and schedule risks; proactively recommend mitigation and recovery actions. Evaluate schedule impacts resulting from customer-requested scope changes and support Extension of Time (EOT) and as-impacted schedule analyses. Perform micro-planning for critical or delayed work packages and develop what-if scenarios to support recovery planning. Reporting, Analytics & Communication Prepare and release project dashboards, KPIs, progress reports, and management presentations for steering committees and senior leadership. Develop and maintain S-Curves, progress measurement systems (Earned value management), and forecast completion metrics for engineering scopes. Issue weekly look-ahead schedules, monthly progress reports, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance reports. Track and report engineering and customer deliverable milestones (LD). Clearly communicate schedule status, risks, and recovery plans to cross-functional stakeholders. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Partner with senior engineering planners to define and continuously improve planning standards, templates, and data management practices. Collaborate across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and external vendors to maintain schedule rigor and execution discipline. Capture lessons learned and planning best practices during project close-out to support continuous improvement across HDNU Gas Power Engineering. Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Mechanical or Electrical engineering. Experience in Engineering Planning, Project Planning, or Equipment Planning within complex industrial or EPC environments. Strong hands-on experience with Primavera P6 scheduling and reporting. Desired Characteristics Demonstrated leadership in planning, scheduling, and cross-functional coordination. Proven expertise in baseline management, float analysis, schedule optimization, and risk- based planning. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex schedule data into actionable insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident presenting to senior leadership and customers. High energy, self-starter mindset with a consistent track record of delivery and execution excellence. Experience supporting proposal, contract, and execution phases in large-scale power or industrial projects. Demonstrated behaviors aligned with The Vernova Way. The role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, handling service operations, managing spare parts logistics, repair activities, and maintaining accurate records in service management tools, and to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and efficient service delivery ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This is not a passive support role - you are expected to own accounts end to end, drive technical delivery, manage stakeholders, and grow revenue through upsells and expansions. We are hiring across multiple sub-roles within Customer Success - from onboarding and activation to key account management and technical project delivery. Each role requires a combination of technical aptitude, commercial instinct and strong client relationship skills. 
 The Basics: Experience: 2 to 10 years Early joiners preferred. Roles & Responsibilities Onboarding & Implementation Own end-to-end client onboarding - from contract closure to first bill generation and successful product adoption. Understand client business requirements and configure, customize and integrate ZoTok within their existing systems. Manage technical project delivery including timelines, milestones and go-live planning. Work with integration tools including Postman, APIs and ERP connectors to ensure seamless setup. Account Management & Revenue Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts - building strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers. Monitor account health scores, product usage and adoption metrics using Odoo and internal CRM tools. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities post-onboarding and drive revenue expansion. Own and manage revenue responsibility for assigned accounts - retention and growth are your KPIs. Sell Done-for-You models where you directly drive business outcomes for clients using ZoTok. Technical & Product Conduct product demonstrations tailored to client-specific needs and industry workflows. Perform QA and UAT validation during implementation to ensure product is configured correctly. Gather and document client requirements using BA methodologies - BRDs, user stories and process maps. Collaborate with internal Tech, Product and Integration teams to resolve client issues promptly. Stakeholder Management Manage internal pushback from client-side blockers and influencers who fear automation - convince them ZoTok makes their work easier. Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders and present performance reports. Provide training to client teams to ensure they are fully equipped to use ZoTok independently. Serve as a trusted advisor - not just a support contact - throughout the client journey. What are we looking for Experience & Background 2-10 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Technical Project Delivery or similar roles in IT/SaaS industry. Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Odoo or similar is a strong advantage. Background in technical implementation, SaaS onboarding or BA roles is highly preferred. Working experience in Distribution, Supply Chain or B2B Commerce industries is a plus. Bachelors degree mandatory - negotiable for candidates with strong relevant experience. Technical Skills Familiarity with Postman, REST APIs and integration workflows. Experience with QA processes, UAT and product testing. Proficiency in CRM tools - Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot or similar. Basic understanding of ERP workflows - SAP, Tally, Zoho or similar. Ability to read and interpret API documentation and integration specs. Soft Skills & Mindset Commercial Instinct - you dont just support clients, you spot expansion opportunities and drive upsells naturally. Stakeholder Management - you can hold a room, manage pushback and get buy-in from skeptical decision-makers. Ownership Mindset - you drive tasks to completion without being told and think proactively about what comes next. Communication - excellent verbal and written communication with clients, leadership and internal teams. Adaptability - ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. 
 What matters more than the resume: Stakeholder Management & Persuasion: You can hold a room and manage pushback from insecure internal influencers who fear automation. Technical - Postman, REST APIs, QA/UAT, CRM tools (Salesforce, Odoo), ERP background (SAP, Tally, Zoho) - advantage. Domain - Supply chain, distribution, B2B commerce or SaaS implementation background - strongly preferred. Mindset - Commercial instinct, ownership, stakeholder management and hunger to make clients genuinely successful. Commercial Instinct: You dont just support clients; you spot expansion opportunities and naturally drive upsells post-onboarding. Industry & SaaS Context: Deep familiarity with supply chain, distribution, or B2B SaaS workflows to guide clients. 
 Why Join ZoTok At ZoTok, you wont be managing accounts - you will be shaping how Indias businesses operate on WhatsApp. Youll work at the intersection of AI, commerce and technology, building something that has never been done before in India. 
 Be part of Indias first Network CRM for conversational commerce - a category-defining product. Work directly with Brands, Distributors and Retailers across Indias $1 trillion+ General Trade ecosystem. Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Management and B2B SaaS - skills that compound over time. Fast-paced, ownership-driven culture where your impact is visible and rewarded. Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale rapidly across India and globally. ZoTok occupies a niche market with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary - redefining Conversational Commerce in India and beyond. title: Mainframe MVS / z/OS System Administrator
description:
Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. 
 The Role As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients - which means some of the biggest in the world.
 
There s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage z/OS system programming initiatives Design resilient and scalable mainframe infrastructure Handle upgrades, migrations, and SMP/E maintenance Manage core components: JES, storage, networking Support CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ subsystems Drive automation, performance, and capacity optimization Resolve critical incidents and perform root cause analysis Ensure security, compliance, and SLA adherence Support disaster recovery and monitoring integration Collaborate with teams, vendors, and stakeholders Mentor team members and drive modernization efforts 
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times Yes! But you ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
 
Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. 
 Who You Are You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience 7+ Yrs Expertise in IBM z/OS system programming with strong knowledge of z/OS internals and architecture Proficiency in SMP/E installation, maintenance, and upgrade management Hands-on experience with JES2/JES3 administration and operations In-depth understanding of mainframe storage (DASD, DFSMS, HSM) and networking (TCP/IP, VTAM) Enterprise subsystem support for CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ Skills in performance tuning, capacity planning, dump analysis, and advanced problem determination Strong root cause analysis capability for critical incidents Experience with automation and scheduling tools on z/OS Expertise in system upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives Knowledge of security administration and compliance management on z/OS Familiarity with disaster recovery and high availability concepts Experience with monitoring and observability tools for mainframe environments Proven ability in production support within SLA-driven environments Understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes Scripting skills using Shell, REXX, or CLIST Experience in vendor coordination and defect resolution Demonstrated leadership in enterprise mainframe operations Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Strong expertise in IBM z/OS architecture design and engineering, including knowledge of Parallel Sysplex and GDPS Hands-on experience with IBM Tivoli, OMEGAMON, NetView, and System Automation tools Proven capability in mainframe automation, self-healing platform implementation, and AIOps-driven observability integration Familiarity with DevOps practices for mainframe environments and hybrid cloud integration Knowledge of z/OS security products such as RACF, ACF2, and Top Secret Experience in capacity forecasting and enterprise optimization strategies Exposure to modernization and transformation programs and defining enterprise operational standards Experience with modern automation frameworks such as Ansible and Zowe Understanding of mainframe API enablement and integration technologies Knowledge of compliance, audit frameworks, and ITIL-based service management practices Cross-platform infrastructure integration experience Strong mentoring, technical leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities Focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives 
 Being You The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That s The Kyndryl Way. 
 What You Can Expect Your career with us isn t just a job-it s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health-because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
 
From your very first day, you ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won t just contribute-you ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
 
We re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities-from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
 
We want you to thrive here-and we re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact Join us and help shape what s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked How Did You Hear About Us during the application process, select Employee Referral and enter your contacts Kyndryl email address.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Embedded Software Developer Job Summary 
 We are looking for an Embedded Software Developer responsible for designing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining embedded software and firmware for microcontroller-based products. 
 The candidate will work closely with hardware and software teams to develop reliable and efficient embedded applications, device drivers, communication protocols, and firmware for various embedded systems. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software/firmware using C/C++. Develop firmware for Bare-Metal microcontroller-based systems. Understand software requirements and translate them into robust and maintainable firmware. Develop and integrate device drivers for microcontroller peripherals and external devices. Work with peripherals and interfaces such as: GPIO ADC/DAC Timers and PWM UART/USART SPI I2C CAN RS-485 / Modbus Ethernet Develop software for interfacing with sensors, actuators, memory devices, communication modules, and other peripherals. Implement interrupt-driven and DMA-based firmware where required. Develop and integrate communication protocols between embedded devices and external systems. Develop firmware features such as bootloaders, firmware upgrades/FOTA, watchdogs, fault handling, and system recovery mechanisms where required. Debug and troubleshoot embedded software using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, serial tools, and other debugging equipment. Identify software defects, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective solutions. Optimize firmware for execution speed, memory usage, CPU utilization, power consumption, and reliability. Perform unit testing, integration testing, and system-level testing of embedded software. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, software documentation, and technical discussions. Maintain source code using Git or other version-control systems. Collaborate with hardware engineers during PCB bring-up and hardware/software integration. Support product validation, field testing, and resolution of firmware-related issues. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, Embedded Systems, or a related field. Relevant practical experience may also be considered. Proven experience in embedded software/firmware development. Strong programming skills in Embedded C. Good knowledge of C++ is an advantage. Strong understanding of microcontroller architecture and Bare-Metal programming. Good understanding of: Interrupts Timers DMA GPIO ADC PWM Memory management Peripheral programming Hands-on experience with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS-485, and Modbus. Experience with debugging and troubleshooting embedded software. Good understanding of software development practices including version control, debugging, testing, code reviews, and documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently as well as in a cross-functional team. Good written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Skills 
 Experience with any of the following will be an added advantage: 
 STM32 or similar ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. STM32 HAL, LL, or register-level programming. Sensor interfacing and data acquisition systems. SD card, SPI Flash, EEPROM, or other non-volatile memory. BLE / Bluetooth. GSM/4G, Wi-Fi, GNSS, or Ethernet. Low-power and battery-operated embedded systems. Bootloader development and FOTA/OTA firmware updates. Modbus RTU/TCP and industrial communication protocols. CAN communication. Embedded networking and TCP/IP. Git and Git-based development workflows. Experience with embedded products from prototype development through production and field deployment. Core Technical Skills 
 Must Have: Embedded C | Microcontrollers | Bare-Metal Programming | GPIO | Interrupts | Timers | UART | SPI | I2C | Debugging 
 Good to Have: C++ | STM32 | DMA | CAN | RS-485 | Modbus | BLE | GSM/4G | Ethernet | Bootloader | FOTA | Git 
 Experience 
 2-5 years of experience in embedded software/firmware development. 
 Candidates with strong hands-on embedded programming skills and relevant project experience may also be considered irrespective of their exact years of experience.

description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don t just provide data; we provide certainty . We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500 , protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria s Secret . As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. The Culture Memo: Our Operating System Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time. Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup. The Perks & Ownership: We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success. Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 
 Role Overview: We are looking for an SDE II - Sensors to build customer-deployed security software that runs inside enterprise environments and continuously discovers assets, evaluates exposures, and securely communicates telemetry back to SAFE. 
 This role is suited for engineers with strong C++, Go or Python programming skills, Windows/Linux, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals , particularly those who have worked on endpoint agents, security sensors, network/security products, or other long-running system software . What Youll Do: Design and develop lightweight security sensors/agents running inside customer environments. Build capabilities for asset discovery, network scanning, vulnerability detection and exposure validation . Develop reliable, long-running system software with a focus on performance, resource usage, concurrency, and stability . Work extensively with Windows/Linux internals, processes, sockets, filesystems, networking and system APIs . Build communication between distributed sensors and the SAFE cloud with secure authentication, encryption, retries and offline recovery . Implement sensor lifecycle management, including installation, configuration, health monitoring and software/rule updates. Debug complex issues spanning application code, operating systems, customer networks, proxies, firewalls and infrastructure . Build strong diagnostics, telemetry and logging so problems can be investigated without requiring direct access to customer systems. Participate in low-level and high-level design discussions and independently own well-defined components/features through production. What Were Looking For: 3-6 years of software development experience , preferably building systems, infrastructure or security products. Strong programming experience in one or more of C++, Go or Python . Strong understanding of Windows/Linux and operating-system fundamentals . Good understanding of networking concepts, including: TCP/IP and sockets DNS HTTP/HTTPS TLS Proxies Routing NAT Firewalls and network segmentation Experience with multithreading/concurrency, asynchronous programming and inter-process communication . Understanding of software security and secure communication practices. Ability to troubleshoot issues independently across code, OS and network boundaries . Strongly Preferred: Experience building endpoint agents, sensors, collectors, daemons or system services . Experience working on cybersecurity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, micro-segmentation, EDR or network security products . Experience building software deployed across large heterogeneous enterprise environments . Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, vulnerability scanners and exposure management . Experience with secure auto-update / software distribution mechanisms . Familiarity with containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes . Experience developing software that needs to operate reliably across Windows and Linux environments . What Good Looks Like: You should be comfortable going beyond: "The API returned an error." and investigating: Sensor process socket DNS proxy/firewall network cloud service to determine exactly where and why something failed. You should be equally comfortable reasoning about: Why is a process consuming excessive CPU or memory Why communication works in one customer network but fails in another How to safely upgrade thousands of deployed sensors How to recover when a sensor loses connectivity for several hours How to execute security scans without destabilising customer infrastructure How to collect enough diagnostics to troubleshoot systems you cannot directly access The ideal candidate is fundamentally a systems/security engineer who can build reliable software , rather than a conventional CRUD/backend application developer. If you re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that s redefining security, we want to hear from you!

description:

Automation/scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and ability to reduce manual operational work. The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for improving the reliability, availability, performance, and operability of PAH-supported software systems. This role combines software engineering and IT operations to automate operational work, monitor system performance, and reduce toil. The SRE establishes and manages monitoring, ing, incident response, and problem management practices to ensure applications remain available and performant during updates and failures. The role partners with engineering, architecture, and product teams to define reliability standards and production readiness requirements. SRE is a practical implementation of DevOps focused on maintaining software quality in fast-paced development environments. Define, implement, and maintain observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) and actionable ing aligned to service health. Drive incident management: on-call readiness, triage, incident command support, communications, and post-incident reviews (RCA)
Reduce operational toil through automation (runbooks-to-automation, self-healing, deployment/rollback automation).
 Establish reliability standards: SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, production readiness reviews, and release risk controls Performance and reliability engineering: capacity planning, load/performance analysis, resilience testing, and failure-mode mitigation Partner with engineering teams to improve operational hygiene (deployability, rollback strategy, configuration, secrets, dependency management)

Orchestration depth: Apply agent design patterns with judgment - memory, tool routing, multi-agent coordination, and explicit failure handling - and decide deliberately where autonomy stops and a human takes over. Retrieval quality: Own the retrieval pipeline as a first-class system: chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector stores, re-ranking, and relevance tuning against measured outcomes. LLMOps lifecycle: Own model and prompt versioning, eval pipelines running in CI, observability (tracing, token and cost dashboards), and the guardrails and safety filters that ship with every release. Model strategy: Select, fine-tune, and serve SLMs and open models - LoRA and QLoRA, quantization, inference optimization, GPU and serving trade-offs. Engineering economics: Optimize latency, cost, and accuracy together, and make defensible build-versus-buy and model-selection calls you can explain to both engineers and executives. Beyond the codebase Define and execute the quarterly roadmap for your area, and translate ambiguous business problems into machine learning problems with clear solution workflows. Work with business leaders and customers directly to understand where the workflow actually breaks, then build for that. Partner with the data platform and applications teams so your capabilities land inside their products and workflows rather than beside them. Set the coding and evaluation standards for your team, and lead design reviews. Pursue published work or patents where the problem warrants it - particularly in healthcare AI. What You Need 6+ years in data science, applied ML, or AI engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-powered products. Healthcare experience is a plus. Deep NLP and GenAI experience. Statistical and classical machine learning is good to have on top of that. Strong hands-on Python - building highly scalable, performant enterprise applications, plus optimization technique. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks: PyTorch and/or HuggingFace transformers. At least one shipped GenAI product with a genuinely complex architecture - multiple agents, memory, retrieval, and agent OTEL/tracing in production. Working command of modern fine-tuning: PEFT methods, with LoRA and QLoRA preferred. Hands-on experience with at least one ML platform - Databricks, Azure ML, or SageMaker. Experience leading engineers, formally or as a technical lead - you have owned other people's output, not only your own. Strong written and spoken communication, with a customer-focused instinct in both conversation and documentation. Preferably a Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. The engineering baseline we assume Everything above sits on top of independent delivery. This role assumes you can already do the following without supervision: Build production-grade RAG and LLM/SLM-powered features end to end with limited supervision. Work fluently in at least one orchestration framework - LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or equivalent - to compose multi-step, tool-using flows. Design retrieval pipelines and tune them for relevance: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, re-ranking. Implement prompt engineering, function and tool calling, and reliable structured-output parsing. Write and run evals - golden sets, LLM-as-judge - to measure quality and catch regressions before customers do. Containerize and deploy services (Docker, REST/gRPC) with an eye on latency, token cost, and basic guardrails. Document well and participate actively in code review. Good to have API frameworks for robust web applications - FastAPI or Django preferred. Comfort with at least one hyperscaler cloud. Papers or patents, especially in healthcare AI.

As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in scaling our architecture to handle high-speed traffic, extreme environmental edge cases (mud, glare, tampering), and highly localized typography. Tracking & Heuristics: Implement and refine temporal tracking logic and spatial prior mathematics to stabilize OCR predictions and handle object occlusion. Multimodal Fusion Readiness: Collaborate on architecting feature embeddings that fuse 2D visual data with physical sensor telemetry (LiDAR profiling, Radar speed). Edge Optimization: Collaborate with deployment engineers to ensure models adhere to strict latency and compute constraints for real-time edge hardware execution.

 We are seeking an experienced Payroll Specialist/Senior Payroll Specialist to manage end-to-end payroll operations for India. The ideal candidate is a subject-matter expert in India payroll and statutory compliance, with direct, hands-on experience helping organizations adjust to new Labour Codes and revised income tax regimes. This role requires a detail-oriented professional and ensures accurate and timely payroll processing, statutory compliance, vendor management, and employee support, with a strong understanding of India payroll regulations, payroll systems, and stakeholder management. Key Responsibilities India Payroll Management Manage end-to-end payroll processing for employees in India, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Ensure compliance with all Indian labor laws and statutory requirements, including: Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Income Tax (TDS), Gratuity and other applicable regulations Coordinate monthly payroll reconciliations and maintain payroll records and reports. Payroll Governance & Compliance Ensure adherence to internal controls, company policies, and local regulatory requirements. Lead the organization s readiness and compliance efforts for India s new Labour Codes (Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions) as they are rolled out and notified by state. Assess the impact of new Labour Code and tax regime changes on compensation structures, payroll calculations, benefits, and statutory contributions, and drive the changes needed to stay compliant. Advise leadership and Corporate Total Rewards on the compliance implications of old vs. new income tax regime elections and related employee communications. Track legislative developments and proactively flag compliance risks and required process changes. Drive payroll process improvements and standardization initiatives. Maintain confidentiality and security of employee payroll data. Perform payroll-related audits, compliance reviews, and reporting activities. Employee Support & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll-related employee queries. Collaborate with HR, Finance, Tax, Benefits, Compensation, and external payroll vendors. Provide payroll analysis, reports, and insights to business stakeholders as needed. 
 
 Systems & Reporting Utilize HRIS and payroll systems effectively for payroll administration and reporting. Prepare monthly payroll reports, variance analysis, reconciliations, and management dashboards. Support payroll system implementations, enhancements, and testing activities when required. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in human resources, Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or related field. 5-8 years of India payroll experience. Demonstrated, hands-on experience leading compliance efforts tied to India s new Labour Codes and the new income tax regimes Deep knowledge of Indian payroll legislation, taxation (TDS), and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity). Experience managing payroll vendors and third-party payroll providers. Hands-on experience with HRIS and payroll systems. Workday and ADP Celergo preferred. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and payroll reconciliations. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. High attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. Preferred Qualifications Experience working for multinational corporation in a centralized corporate function, supporting assigned geographic regions. Exposure to payroll operations across APAC, EMEA, and/or Americas regions. Experience in payroll transitions, process improvement, or automation initiatives. About This Opportunity We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.   What You Will Do 

  Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
  Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
  Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
  Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
  Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
  Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
  Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
  Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
  Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
  Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
  Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
  Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
  Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation 
  Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
  Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
  Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
  Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs   What You Will Bring 

  Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
  Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
  Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
  Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
  Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes   Experience & Qualifications 
 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
  Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent 
 Preferred Qualifications 
  ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
  Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
  Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM

Key Skills: CS Core,Problem Management,RCA,Hss,Incident Management,HLR,Management,Cs

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Broad function: The Senior Data Engineer - VARTA SENSE will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing scalable and reliable data pipelines that form the core data foundation of the VARTA SENSE platform. The role will work closely with the ML Lead, Solution Architect, Backend Engineering team and other technology stakeholders to transform complex banking and transaction data into standardized, reusable and production-ready datasets and features. The position requires strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, data pipelines, orchestration, data quality and distributed data processing, with particular emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability and secure deployment within restricted banking environments. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Data Pipeline Development & Engineering: Design and develop scalable batch, incremental and production-grade data pipelines for large volumes of transaction and customer data. Build standardized and reusable data models and canonical schemas for transactions, customer attributes, offers, exposure and outcome events. Develop configurable ingestion and mapping frameworks to integrate data received from different banks and source systems. Manage pipeline orchestration including dependencies, checkpointing, retries, partial failures, backfills and safe replay mechanisms. Implement deduplication, late-arriving data handling, incremental loads, CDC, watermarking and merge/upsert processing. Data Quality, Reconciliation & Governance: Establish strong data-quality controls, automated testing, source-to-target reconciliation and schema validation. Ensure data lineage and schema evolution are properly managed across pipelines. Proactively identify and prevent issues such as missing data, duplicate records, incorrect aggregations, silent data loss and double counting. Maintain reliable and auditable data-processing standards across production environments. ML Feature Engineering Support: Work closely with the ML Lead to develop and maintain analytical and ML feature pipelines. Ensure consistency between training and production/inference datasets. Maintain point-in-time correctness and prevent data leakage within feature pipelines. Support versioned analytical features and reusable feature definitions. Performance & Scalability: Optimize large-scale data-processing workloads through effective partitioning, query optimization, join strategies, memory management and I/O optimization. Benchmark workloads against expected transaction volumes and available infrastructure. Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve processing speed, stability and infrastructure utilization. Ensure data pipelines remain scalable as transaction volumes and customer deployments increase. Deployment, Security & Production Reliability: Develop and support pipelines for deployment within bank-controlled on-premise and private-cloud environments. Ensure pipelines can operate in restricted or offline environments without public-internet dependency at runtime. Implement appropriate controls for PII handling, encryption, tokenization, masking, access management and secure connectivity. Establish monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures, data-quality issues, infrastructure bottlenecks and processing delays. Define and maintain backfill, replay, recovery and disaster-recovery procedures for critical pipelines. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with ML, Architecture, Backend Engineering, DevOps and Infrastructure teams to design and deliver reliable data solutions. Collaborate with development partners to reproduce, transition and operationalize data pipelines within FCI. Support integration between data platforms and downstream application / ML services. Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews and production troubleshooting. Reusability, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Build reusable adapters and configuration layers so that onboarding a new bank can be managed through configuration and mapping rather than changes to the core product code. Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures. Document architecture decisions, troubleshooting steps and recovery procedures. Enable alternate engineering resources to independently operate and troubleshoot critical pipelines. Participate in code reviews, Git-based development, CI/CD practices and continuous improvement of engineering standards. 
 
 Requirements 
 5-9 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, with hands-on ownership of production-grade data pipelines. Strong hands-on expertise in Python and Advanced SQL. Strong understanding of SQL concepts including window functions, query optimization and query-plan analysis. Practical experience with distributed data-processing platforms such as Apache Spark / PySpark or equivalent technologies. Experience building and managing production pipelines using Apache Airflow or an equivalent orchestration framework. Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch processing and incremental data pipelines. Experience working with Parquet and other columnar data formats, partitioning, schema evolution and reconciliation. Practical experience with CDC / incremental ingestion technologies and concepts. Exposure to technologies such as Kafka, Debezium or equivalent event / CDC platforms would be preferred. Experience implementing automated Data Quality frameworks using tools such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda or equivalent. Understanding of Data Lineage and Metadata Management using OpenLineage, Marquez or similar self-hosted solutions would be an advantage. Experience with lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi would be preferred. Exposure to Feature Store platforms such as Feast or equivalent would be beneficial. Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Docker and Linux environments. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent platforms. Strong understanding of production support, troubleshooting, performance tuning and failure recovery. Ability to clearly explain technical design decisions, performance trade-offs and production engineering challenges. Strong collaboration skills with Data Science, ML, Backend Engineering, Architecture and Infrastructure teams.

title: Staff Engineer - Platform (Database & Data Infrastructure)
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Staff Engineer - Database & Data Infrastructure to help define and drive the technical direction of database infrastructure across the company. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who has designed and operated database systems at significant scale and can apply that experience to company-wide challenges. You will work across engineering teams to shape database architecture, establish scalable patterns and platforms, anticipate future constraints, and lead initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, developer experience, and infrastructure efficiency. This is not a traditional DBA role. While deep database expertise is essential, the role is focused on architecture, platform strategy, and company-level technical impact. Responsibilities Define and evolve the long-term database and data infrastructure strategy across the company. Design architectures capable of supporting the next order of magnitude of growth in data volume and traffic. Establish architectural standards and paved roads for database selection, data modeling, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, availability, and data lifecycle. Lead complex, cross-team initiatives such as database migrations, re-platforming, sharding, multiregion architectures, and major scalability improvements. Identify systemic reliability, scalability, and capacity risks before they become critical production problems. Drive database platform capabilities that make infrastructure more self-service, observable, reliable, and easier to operate for engineering teams. Develop strategies for capacity planning, data growth, archival, disaster recovery, and infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to materially improve database infrastructure cost and performance at company scale. Evaluate new database technologies and architectures and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and technology-selection decisions. Partner with senior engineers and engineering leadership on architecture and long-term technical direction. Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for database and distributed-systems engineering across the organization. Requirements Significant experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior individual contributor, solving infrastructure or database problems across multiple teams. Deep understanding of database internals and distributed systems, including storage, indexing, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, transactions, availability, and failure modes. Experience designing and operating production database systems with multi-terabyte or larger datasets. Experience with high-throughput systems handling 30K-50K+ operations per second, preferably at substantially higher scale. Strong production experience across multiple database technologies and database architectures, including both relational and NoSQL/distributed systems. Experience leading major architectural changes, migrations, or scaling initiatives involving multiple engineering teams. Strong understanding of database reliability, capacity planning, observability, and infrastructure economics. Ability to take ambiguous technical problems, establish a direction, build alignment, and drive them through execution. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence engineers and engineering leadership without relying on organizational authority. Relevant Technology Experience We value breadth of database architecture experience and depth of fundamentals over expertise in our specific technology stack. Experience in any programming language like Node.js, Java, Python Experience with several technologies such as the following would be relevant: Relational & Distributed SQL: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Amazon Aurora, Google Cloud Spanner, CockroachDB, TiDB, YugabyteDB, Vitess NoSQL & Distributed Databases: MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, ScyllaDB, HBase, Cosmos DB, Couchbase, Firestore Search & High-Throughput Systems: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis/Valkey Large-Scale Analytical Systems: ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, Pinot, Druid You do not need experience with all of these technologies. We are looking for engineers who understand database and distributed-system fundamentals deeply enough to reason about trade-offs and make strong architectural decisions across different technologies What Success Looks Like Build database architecture that can support 5-10 future growth Reduce systemic reliability and scalability risks Simplify how engineering teams consume and operate database infrastructure Make better company-wide technology and architecture decisions Improve the economics of operating databases at scale Establish technical standards that continue to create value as the organization grows Success in this role is measured by the lasting technical and organizational impact you create - not simply by the systems you personally build or operate. We are looking for an engineer who can combine Deep database expertise Distributed systems thinking Architectural judgment Strong execution Company-wide technical influence

You will also have strong database performance engineering skills and be comfortable analysing execution plans, identifying performance bottlenecks, designing appropriate indexing and partitioning strategies, and refactoring poorly performing SQL and database routines. This is a database engineering and development role rather than a traditional DBA. Proven experience developing complex native SQL transformations across multiple tables and data models. Experience transforming data from legacy source models into canonical or target data models. Strong understanding of set-based processing and designing scalable database logic for large data volumes.
